review.assessment: This change adds three new invite handlers (`api.py`, `bulk_csv.py`, `sso.py`) that iterate over provided emails and unconditionally call `team.add_member(email)`. None of them perform a capacity check, meaning any invocation can push `seats_used` past the configured `seat_limit`. This directly violates the stated invariant.

findings.actual: The loop completes fully, calling `team.add_member(email)` for every email in the input list regardless of current team size. `seats_used` increments unconditionally and exceeds `seat_limit`.
findings.at: invites/api.py:5-7 (and identically in bulk_csv.py and sso.py)
findings.call: Invoking any of these functions with excess emails, e.g., `invites.api.invite(team, ['x@acme.com'] * 20)` when near capacity
findings.defect: Missing seat limit enforcement in all three new invite paths.
findings.expected: Processing should halt or reject excess emails once `seats_used` hits `seat_limit`; no more than the remaining allowance are accepted.
